title: Codex Commit Safe project policy
description: Repository-owned policy for Codex Commit Safe. Only the copy committed in HEAD is applied.

language.description: Language used for generated commit descriptions and bodies.

subjectMaxLength.description: Preferred maximum length of the generated commit subject.

maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum staged diff size accepted for one generation request.

maxBodyChars.description: Maximum total generated commit message length.

scopes.description: Preferred Conventional Commit scopes. Duplicate entries are unnecessary.

scopeHints.description: Static semantic aliases used by local scope inference. Every key must also appear in the effective scopes list.

scopePolicy.description: Whether generated non-empty scopes may extend beyond the configured scopes list.

autoInferScope.description: Enable local staged-path and changed-diff scope inference.

extraInstructions.description: Additional team style guidance. It cannot override Codex Commit Safe safety constraints.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum Codex generation time in seconds.
